title: Homogenized affine linear form
statement: For a natural number $n$, a real constant $a_0$, and a real coefficient vector $a=(a_1,\ldots,a_n)$, the homogenized affine linear form on sign vectors $x\in\{-1,1\}^{n+1}$ is $\sum_{i=0}^{n} b_i x_i$, where $b_0=a_0$ and $b_i=a_i$ for $1\le i\le n$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is a real coefficient vector indexed by $n$ coordinates
the input is a sign vector of length $n+1$
